items.stem: Name the instrument used to detect the presence of a current in a circuit.
items.answer: Galvanometer.

items.stem: What is the function of galvanometer in a circuit?
items.answer: Galvanometer is a device that detects the presence of current in a circuit. It is also used for measuring the amount of current in the circuit.

items.stem: Write the function of voltmeter in an electric circuit.
items.answer: Voltmeter measures the potential difference across two points in a circuit. It is always connected in parallel in the circuit.

items.stem: If the charge on an electron be 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, find the approximate number of electrons in 1 C.
items.answer: Charge, q = ne. Here e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C and q = 1 C, so n = q/e = 1 / (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹) = 6.25 × 10¹⁸ electrons.
